PRICING

Pay per case, not per head.

Pricing is quoted after a parallel run on your own volume and mix. We do not publish a rate card, because a number that is not a sourced fact, a labelled target, or sample data does not belong on this site.

Book a demoHow we start

How we charge

  • Per case

    End-to-end case processing, priced per case completed.

  • Per molecule per month

    Literature screening for a molecule, billed monthly.

  • Per case checked

    Audit of an external vendor or internal team, per case reviewed.

  • Per report

    Aggregate and periodic safety reports, priced per report.

The retrospective benchmark is free. Production pricing is written into the contract with quality targets and service credits. Ask for a quote after the parallel run — see How we start.
